title: galium californicum subsp. flaccidum
intro: Galium californicum subsp. flaccidum, commonly known as California licorice or flaccid bedstraw, is a subspecies of the Galium californicum plant. It is a perennial herb that has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including digestive support and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its ability to calm the nervous system, reduce inflammation, and soothe digestive issues, making it a popular natural remedy for stress relief and gastrointestinal problems. The bioactive constituents of Galium californicum subsp. flavescens include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
